name: cockpit
description: Makes a Claude Code session's work visible: tool call batches on the spinner, a per-turn summary line, and more.

batchTrace.title: Tool call batch tracing
batchTrace.description: Show the tool call batches of the running turn after the spinner, and a summary line under each answer.

batchTraceMaxShown.title: Batches shown before truncating
batchTraceMaxShown.description: The longest batch sequence the summary line shows in full. Longer sequences keep their first and last batches and fold the middle.
